Dear Madam
I do not think your duties are very definite.[^1]
1st to induce a bookseller within easy reach of your Branch to keep a depôt of [GFS](../others.html#23) literature
2d To manage the Book slate at festivals
3d to know the numbers of GFS magazines taken in the Branch
4th to know whether the girls have access to lending libraries and if books are borrowed from the Diocesan Library to manage the correspondence
5th To fill up the report for me

Yours truly
C.M.

Yonge

[^1]: As branch organizer of the Girls’ Friendly Society.
